content.text: {"issues":[{"key":"start.csLine","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"עד {n} עמים בני עיר אחת, כל אחד במרחק {km} ק״מ או יותר מכל התחלה. ערים של מסחר, צבא, מדע ותרבות מתגמלות את העם שהן מעדיפות; שליש מהן לכל היותר שודדות.","why":"The pronoun 'הן' and the verb 'שודדים' are masculine, but they refer to feminine 'ערים'. The sentence should agree with the cities."},{"key":"start.diff.settler.desc","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"עמי המחשב פסיביים ונדירים להכריז מלחמה. אתם מתחילים עם 50% יותר משאבים, והמחשב עם 25% פחות.","why":"'50%+' and '25%-' are symbol shorthand that a Hebrew player would not read naturally. 'נדיר שיכריזו' is also stiff."},{"key":"start.diff.chieftain.desc","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"מחשב זהיר. אתם מתחילים עם 20% יותר משאבים.","why":"'20%+' is machine-like shorthand; Hebrew says 'X% יותר'."},{"key":"start.diff.king.desc","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"עמי המחשב מקבלים 25% יותר משאבים ותוקפניים יותר.","why":"'25%+' is symbol shorthand instead of the natural 'X% יותר'."},{"key":"start.diff.emperor.desc","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"עמי המחשב מקבלים 50% יותר משאבים והם אכזריים: בנייה נגדית מושלמת ומלחמות מתואמות.","why":"'50%+' is symbol shorthand instead of the natural 'X% יותר'."},{"key":"prompt.block.peace","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"ענו: {name} מציע שלום","why":"{name} is a single people, so the verb should be singular ('מציע'), not plural."},{"key":"prompt.block.demandCity","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"ענו: {name} דורש את {city}","why":"{name} is singular, so 'דורש' is needed instead of plural 'דורשים'."},{"key":"prompt.demand.city","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"{name} דורש את {city}","why":"Verb number does not agree with the singular {name}."},{"key":"prompt.mapOffer","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"{name} מציע להחליף מפות","why":"Verb number does not agree with the singular {name}."},{"key":"prompt.warOnYou","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"{name} הכריז עליכם מלחמה","why":"Verb 'הכריזו' is plural, but {name} is a single people; it should be 'הכריז'."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"m.turn.starveOne","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"{n} מהיחידה שלך גוועת ברעב בשטח","why":"Written as 'יחידה {n}', the number reads as a unit number (unit 1, unit 2), not as a count of units."},{"key":"m.turn.meltedOne","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"{n} יחידה התפוררה","why":"Written as 'יחידה {n}', the number reads as a unit number rather than a count of one unit."},{"key":"m.turn.noOilOne","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"אין נפט: {n} יחידה ממוכנת שלך בלי דלק ולא יכולה לזוז בתור הזה. בנו בארות נפט או סחרו בנפט.","why":"'יחידה ממוכנת {n}' reads as 'mechanised unit number n'; the count should come before the noun, as in the plural line."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"m.battle.raidersNear.one","problem":"placeholder","severity":1,"fix":"{raiders} נמצאים במרחק {count} משבצת מ{place}.","why":"The English source uses {count}, but the Hebrew singular line drops it and hardcodes 'one tile'. The placeholder should appear in the Hebrew too."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"m.act.march","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"{who} יוצא לדרך אל {dest}: {turns}. (use a plural verb form when {who} is \"{n} ספינות\" or \"{n} יחידות\", e.g. \"יוצאות\" / \"יוצאים\")","why":"The verb \"יוצא\" is singular, but {who} can expand to a plural phrase such as \"3 ספינות\" or \"3 יחידות\", so number agreement breaks."},{"key":"m.act.marchAttack","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"{who} על {dest} כדי לתקוף אותה: {turns}{stops}. (make the verb agree with a plural {who}, e.g. \"צועדות\" / \"צועדים\", when {who} is \"{n} ספינות\" or \"{n} יחידות\")","why":"The phrasing assumes a singular subject, but {who} can be a plural count, so agreement fails in those cases."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"pevt.coastal_trade_boom.desc","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"{city} מתעשרת ממסחר, ונמליה עמוסים בספינות זרות הלהוטות לעשות עסקים.","why":"The source means 'enriched by trade', which in Hebrew takes the preposition מ (ממסחר), not a bare noun."},{"key":"uclass.naval","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"ימי","why":"'ים' is the word for sea, not a unit class name. The class label should be an adjective like 'ימי'."},{"key":"unit.kingdoms.siege","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"טרבוקט","why":"'טרבושה' is an uncommon rendering of trebuchet. 'טרבוקט' is the usual Hebrew term in military history."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"evt.crisis_steppe_surge.desc","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"רוכבים מהערבות ... רועי הערבות בתנועה, במספרים שאיש לא ראה. כפרי הספר שולחים לבקש עזרה.","why":"steppe means the grassland/steppe, not 'lands that are dry'. The Hebrew term for steppe is ערבות, and 'ארצות היבשות' reads as 'the continents' and misleads the player."},{"key":"evt.deck_radio_mast_3.desc","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"דיווחים כוזבים על קריסת בנק מתפשטים ברדיו וגורמים לבהלה בקרב לקוחות הבנקים.","why":"'מול הבנקים' (in front of the banks) is an awkward way to say the panic is among the banks' customers."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"menu.cloudSynced","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"שמירות בענן: נשמרו","why":"The subject \"שמירות\" is plural, so the verb must agree and read \"נשמרו\", not the singular \"נשמר\"."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"cy.crown.reclaims","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"{n} תורות עד ש{owner} תשלוט בה שוב","why":"\"לידיה\" (to her hands) reads oddly for a nation or state owner; \"תשלוט בה שוב\" states the same idea more naturally."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"indep.form.raiders.early","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"להקת {people}","why":"\"הורדה\" in modern Hebrew reads as \"download\" and does not clearly mean a raiding horde, so players would be confused."},{"key":"indep.form.raiders.middle","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"להקת {people}","why":"Same issue as the early form: \"הורדת\" reads as \"download\" rather than a raiding band."},{"key":"boost.military_gunpowder_weapons","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"להיות במלחמה עם 8 ערים","why":"\"להילחם במלחמה\" is redundant. \"להיות במלחמה עם\" is the natural phrasing and matches ach.three_front_war."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"tax.extortionate","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"מסים מחניקים","why":"The adjective form for taxes that choke is the hif'il participle מחניקים; מחנקים is a different, less accurate form."},{"key":"indep.form.seaRaiders.modern","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"פיראטים של {people}","why":"A plain plural noun reads more naturally than the construct form פיראטי here."},{"key":"persona.engineer_takeda.desc","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"מומחה מצור, חזית מצור מחלישה שליטה מהר יותר.","why":"צוררת is an obscure word that does not clearly mean siege or besieging; מצור is clearer."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"p1.law.oneShot.martial_law","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"⁦-1⁩ ליציבות עם החקיקה","why":"Better governed by 'ליציבות' than 'יציבות' after a number in this context; minor polish."},{"key":"p1.law.needsTech","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"דורש את {tech}","why":"Hebrew usually takes the definite article before a named technology in this construction."},{"key":"p1.law.needsLess","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"דורש עם פחות {axis}","why":"Fine as is, but 'עם' with 'פחות' conveys the people's trait; the existing phrasing is acceptable, so no change needed."},{"key":"p1.gov.authorityLine","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"סמכות {from} ← {to}.","why":"The arrow ← in Hebrew reads right-to-left, so 'from ← to' is consistent with the key p1.gcd.fromTo; keep consistent but the source 'to' should be a change indicator; verify direction matches the other lines."},{"key":"p1.gcd.fromTo","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"{from} → {to}","why":"In Hebrew reading order a change from A to B is commonly shown with an arrow pointing left (←) as written, but the game uses the same ← for p1.gov.authorityLine; the arrow should point in the same direction as English 'to' progression, so use the standard left-pointing arrow consistently."},{"key":"p1.dom.govHelp","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"קבוצה עם מושל: ⁦+{food}⁩ מזון, ⁦+{prod}%⁩ ייצור, ⁦+{culture}⁩ תרבות, ⁦+{loyalty}⁩ נאמנות וכישור, פחות אי שקט. ללא מושל: {ung} נאמנות. כניסה לתפקיד אורכת {turns} תורות.","why":"Placeholder isolation with ⁦⁩ is inconsistent here since {ung} is unsigned; left as is."},{"key":"p1.dom.govSkill","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"{name} (כישור {skill})","why":"Acceptable; no change needed."},{"key":"p1.mil.campaigning","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"{a} צבאות במערכה · {b} צבאות בבית","why":"Acceptable as written."},{"key":"p1.mil.fortification","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":", תוקפים ביצור","why":"Acceptable as written."},{"key":"p1.no.skillTip","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"{label} {value} מתוך 6: {hint}","why":"Acceptable as written."},{"key":"p1.no.ageStrip","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"{age}, תור {turn}{label}","why":"Acceptable as written."},{"key":"p1.gcd.locks","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"הסמכות יורדת מתחת ל־{n}: אי אפשר לחוקק שום חוק עד שתתאושש.","why":"Acceptable as written."}]}
{"issues":[]}

{"issues":[{"key":"ri.disaster.plague","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"{pct}% מהאנשים חולים, אין גידול; המגפה מתפשטת לערים קרובות, לנמלי ים, לשותפי סחר ולצבאות","why":"\"נמלים\" means ants in Hebrew, so the word is ambiguous here. \"נמלי ים\" is clear, and \"שותפי סחר\" is the natural form."},{"key":"ri.terrainFort","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"ביצור שטח {n}","why":"\"מבצר הקרקע\" is stiff. \"ביצור שטח\" is the usual phrasing for terrain fortification."},{"key":"ri.vassalNoWar","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"אי אפשר להכריז מלחמה כשאתם במעמד של ואסל.","why":"\"וסאלים\" is a transliteration. The Hebrew term for a vassal in this sense is \"ואסל\", or a plain description such as \"כפופים\" works."}]}
{"issues":[{"key":"ri.show","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"הצג","why":"As a button label, the imperative \"הצג\" reads more naturally than the noun \"הצגה\" (display/performance)."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"pevt.deck_great_library.title","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"ספרייה ב{city}","why":"The English 'Library for {city}' means a library located in the city, and Hebrew expresses that with ב, not ל."},{"key":"virtue.arbiterOfNations.text","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"+10 יחס אליך בכל מקום, מדינות עצמאיות מצטרפות אליך מהר ב-25%","why":"'עצמאיים' is a stiff, ambiguous way to say independent nations; 'מדינות עצמאיות' is the natural phrasing."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"m.why.indepOnlyMerc","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"רק עיר סוחרת יכולה לסחור.","why":"The line repeats the same word (סוחרת סוחרת) and reads as broken Hebrew; the English is 'Only a mercantile city trades.'"},{"key":"nc.rivalTitle","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"חייב לחלוק גבול איתכם; יריב שנפל מעניק יוקרה","why":"'לגבול בכם' is a stiff, literal rendering of 'must border you'; a Hebrew game would say 'חולק גבול'."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"m.battle.raidDrivenOff","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"{who} הבריח את {raiders} ב{place}{cut}.","why":"The verb is plural (הבריחו) but {who} is singular elsewhere (e.g. m.battle.fieldWon uses הביס), so the agreement is inconsistent."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"bt.result.afterField","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"ומי שיצא דרך מוצא שורד ונסוג צעד אחורה.","why":"\"סוגג\" is not a normal Hebrew word for stepping back; \"נסוג\" (withdrew) or \"נסוג צעד אחורה\" is the natural phrasing for a unit retreating one tile."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"beco.gunpowder.siegeWorkshop","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"בית יציקת תותחים","why":"\"יצקת תותחים\" is a garbled verb form; the building needs a noun phrase like the other buildings."},{"key":"ambition.tartessosAmbition","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"לסחור בכסף ובבדיל מארצות המערב: לצבור 2 סוגי משאבים חדשים ולהוסיף עיר","why":"\"מנהרות\" means tunnels, not the tin-and-silver sources in the west that the English implies."}]}
{"issues":[]}

{"issues":[{"key":"m.why.noSite","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"אין מקום לזה בעיר.","why":"Shorter, more natural phrasing."},{"key":"nc.shortfallItem","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"{cost} (יש לכם {have})","why":"Clearer with the owner made explicit, matching the other lines using 'you'."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"bt.alert.enemyBroke","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"{name} של האויב נשבר","why":"The verb agrees with the plural in the Hebrew, but the English uses a single squad name, so the singular verb form is correct."},{"key":"bt.screen.graphicsLost","problem":"untranslated","severity":1,"fix":"הגרפיקה אבדה (שגיאת WebGL: context lost).","why":"The raw identifier 'webglcontextlost' is an internal English code and should be presented in a more readable form for players."}]}
{"issues":[]}
{"issues":[{"key":"decree.deed.trickle","problem":"wrong","severity":1,"fix":"שנים שקטות בחצר","why":"Fine as is; no change needed."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"mx.army.scouts","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"סיירים","why":"The label names a unit type, so it should be plural (סיירים) to match 'Scouts' and the other unit labels, not the singular סייר."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"bpower.rallyCry","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"קריאת גיוס","why":"Rally cry is a call to rally troops to battle. \"התעוררות\" means awakening, which doesn't match the game sense."},{"key":"btype.sally.label","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"יציאה לפריצה","why":"Sally means a sortie out of a besieged position. \"פרצה\" means a breach or gap in a wall, which describes a different thing."},{"key":"btype.ambush.defender","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"גרמו לתוקף להפסיד {pct}% ב-{min} הדקות הראשונות","why":"\"גבו מהתוקף\" is a stiff literal rendering and is unclear to a player. The fix states the defender's goal directly."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"p1.go.copyYears","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"תורות שנוגנו: {turns}","why":"\"שוחקו\" (worn down) is an odd word for turns played; \"שנוגנו\" (played) matches the meaning better."},{"key":"p2.rel.vassal","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"משועבד","why":"\"וסאל\" is a transliteration; Hebrew has the common word \"משועבד\" (or \"כפוף\") for a vassal state."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"res.dip","problem":"untranslated","severity":1,"fix":"דיפלומטיה","why":"The English DIP is a Latin abbreviation. Hebrew has a common word for it, so the label should use it, if the space allows."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"bt.card.c.scouted.foe","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"הצופים שלהם ראו את צעדתכם: הלוחמים שלכם מתחילים פחות יציבים.","why":"\"פותחים\" is an awkward literal rendering of \"start\" in a battle context; \"מתחילים\" reads naturally."},{"key":"bt.pre.decideLater","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"להחליט אחר כך: הסתכלו קודם על המפה. ההתקפה ממתינה כשבב.","why":"\"מחכה\" is less natural than \"ממתינה\" for a pending action, and the game term \"chip\" could use a clearer Hebrew phrasing."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"td.c.refuseNone","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"שום דבר שלכם בהשגתם לא שווה פשיטה עכשיו. טינה ⁦+{n}⁩.","why":"The word 'בהישגם' is not a real Hebrew form; the intended word is 'בהשגתם' (within their reach)."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"bt.def.optNoMansTitle","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"מחוץ לגבולות שני העמים, עימות מתנהל באוטומטי","why":"\"עימות נלחם\" is an odd collocation; a clash is fought, and in a game title \"מתנהל\" reads more naturally."},{"key":"bt.def.giveUp","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"ויתור על {place}: ה{ours} שלכם נסוג אל {to} ... (use the verb form matching {ours}: נסוגו for כוחות, נסוגה for עיירה)","why":"The verb \"נסוג\" is singular masculine, but the {ours} values include the plural \"כוחות\" and the feminine \"עיירה\", so gender and number do not agree."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"cy.aTurn","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"{v} לתור","why":"The English means 'per turn', but 'בתור' means 'in the queue', so the line reads as a queue status instead of a rate."},{"key":"cy.governorOf.other","problem":"unnatural","severity":2,"fix":"מושל {count} ערים של {seat}","why":"With a numeral, Hebrew drops the definite article, so 'הערים' is ungrammatical here."},{"key":"p1.personality.logistician","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"לוגיסטיקאי","why":"The standard Hebrew form for this role is 'לוגיסטיקאי'; 'לוגיסטיקן' is a rarer transliteration."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"navalship.transport.gunpowder","problem":"wrong","severity":3,"fix":"גליאון","why":"\"גליון\" means page or newspaper; the intended word is the galleon, transliterated as גליאון."},{"key":"sig.marcomannia","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"לוחמי יער גרמנים כבדים","why":"A Czech LT-38 light tank is a modern unit and doesn't fit the ancient Marcomanni, and the Latin-letter model name is untranslated."},{"key":"sig.sarmatians","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"פרשים סרמטים מכונפים","why":"Winged hussars are the Polish cavalry; the Sarmatians used lancers and horse archers, so the Hebrew unit name doesn't match the civilization."},{"key":"sig.avaria","problem":"wrong","severity":1,"fix":"פרשים אווארים","why":"Hungarian hussars belong to a later period; the Avars are the civilization named here and their cavalry should be labeled as such."},{"key":"sig.srivijaya","problem":"untranslated","severity":1,"fix":"לוחמי הים של סריוויג׳איה (אורנג לאוט)","why":"The parenthetical \"Orang Laut\" is an English-style name left in Latin letters; a Hebrew player would expect a Hebrew gloss or none at all."}]}

{"issues":[{"key":"chip.armyIdle","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"צבא בטל","why":"צבא is masculine, so the adjective must be בטל, not בטלה."},{"key":"prompt.guide.settle.label","problem":"unnatural","severity":1,"fix":"הכשירו מתיישבים והקימו עיר שנייה לאורך הנילוס","why":"לאמן is a stiff choice for training settlers; הכשירו reads more naturally in a game guide."}]}
{"issues":[]}

{"issues":[{"key":"mx.odds.age","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"תקופה","why":"The key refers to the Age (era) matchup, and the sandbox screen uses \"תקופה\" for the same concept. \"טכנולוגיה\" (technology) is a different concept."},{"key":"theme.steppe","problem":"wrong","severity":2,"fix":"הסטפה","why":"\"הערבה\" is the Arava region in Israel and would mislead Hebrew players. The steppe biome is called \"הסטפה\"."},{"key":"de.dip","problem":"untranslated","severity":2,"fix":"דיפלומטיה {v}","why":"\"DIP\" is a Latin-letter abbreviation left in the Hebrew UI. The other resource labels are spelled out in Hebrew, so this one should be too."}]}
